title: Art Psychotherapy
subject: Psychology
summary: Train as an art psychotherapist, using art-making to support people's mental health.
description: This professional training combines psychotherapy theory, your own art practice and supervised clinical placements.
Approved courses lead to registration with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) as an art therapist.
entryRequirements: A degree in art, or in a related subject with a strong art portfolio
Experience of working in a caring or helping role
